messages:
Ravi Desai: Quick sync - ArgentCorp needs a 10-day EU-only POC. Requirements: tenant pinned to eu-west-3, BYO KMS, VPC peering, signed subproc list. Can we confirm owners?
Elena Markov: I can own pricing and AE notes. Do they insist on Dedicated or will hosted hard-pin work?
Samir Khan: infra: We can hard-pin hosted or provision a dedicated small slab in eu-west-3. Dedicated = guaranteed locality; hosted hard-pin requires routing_policy lock and attestation.
Nina Park: Legal: they want a PDF subproc attestation and confirmation that no logs or telemetry leave EU. Need BYO KMS keyflow doc too.
Ravi Desai: Also asked for a config example to include in their security packet.
Samir Khan: Quick snippet to share:
````
routing_policy: tenant_pin
allowed_regions: ["eu-west-3"]
failover: "none_unless_approved"
telemetry: "eu-only"
````
Nina Park: I will draft the POC addendum (no cross-border routing for the POC window, right to pause). Please attach signed subproc PDF.
Elena Markov: Pricing rough: Dedicated demo slab ~€5.2k/week; hosted hard-pin trial ~€1.1k/week + KMS ops ~€400. Will refine.
Samir Khan: Ops ticket created RDW-1702 - "ArgentCorp EU POC: peering + BYO KMS + subproc attestation" assigned to @samir.k
ops-bot: RDW-1702 status -> "in progress"
Ravi Desai: Action items: Samir = runbook + ops ticket; Elena = pricing slide; Nina = addendum + subproc PDF. Aim for first drafts by EOD tomorrow.
Everyone: +1
